name: Emily Sinclair
original_name: エミリィ・シンクレア
source:
A tanky character with low movement but exceptional defense that can mitigate a lot of damage.  She learns several lightning elemental attacks as well as some useful healing spells, thought limited by a low SP pool early on.  

Emily was Eiji's ex-girlfriend back in their Academy's days, but broke up because Emily got hurt while on a mission with Kaitos, and made them abandoned the mission. Therefore, making Kaitos name become bad, who was later known as "Black Ace". Emily feels guilty, and ask for both of them to break up.

Several years later, Emily stopped her carrier as Adventurer and become a Teacher in Agaresta Academy, and become homeroom teacher for class 2-A.
